items.title: Rusty Dedrick interviewed by Monk Rowe, Ellenville, New York, June 23, 1998
items.q: there were three trumpets, Charlie Shavers and I and Al Derisi

ctx.x: Okay. We used to do her dates, and the contractor is now in Nashville, Danny Davis, he has The Nashville Brass. Well he used to put me on all her dates, and we’d go into the studio in the evening and the trumpet players, there were three trumpets, Charlie Shavers and I and Al Derisi, both deceased unfortunately. But they handed out the first chart, no trumpet parts. They had trombone parts. I know Urbie was sitting in front and she was in the booth, you know, singing to Urbie Green, play it this way. No trumpet…
you’re not here.” Well he was right. So I wouldn’t say that was memorable for any special reason other than that.
